title: Action of 2 June 1803
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Action of 2 June 1803", at revision 1370426186, opens: "The Action of 2 June 1803 was a military engagement between the US Navy and the Tripolitans during the First Barbary War. The Americans launched a raid to burn Tripolitan vessels carrying wheat. The raid ended in failure, and the wheat cargo was saved." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q133828702, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1803 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
